status: Original eight approved 2026-09-27; batch 2 user approved Beer Festival, Bring Your Own Bottle, Alcoholics and Robot Workers; requested Friendly Queues v3 integrated 2026-10-03; user-approved Cola Fiends v5 integrated 2026-10-03

cards.name: Extra Pair of Hands
cards.subject: A pair of upright teal festival steward safety vests side by side, the nearer vest larger, simple cream reflective bands and a small golden addition-plus symbol between them. No people, no medical equipment. This means an additional steward hiring slot, not training.

cards.name: Doctor's Orders
cards.subject: One prominent dark teal medical carry bag with a large cream heart emblem, a second smaller matching bag behind, and a golden addition-plus symbol beside them. Clearly a medical hiring-capacity symbol. No red cross, no stewards or vest.

cards.name: Another Round
cards.effect: +1 placeable free-water tap above the guaranteed baseline.
cards.subject: Two distinct upright dark teal outdoor standpipe taps side by side, one taller foreground and one slightly smaller behind, each spout clearly visible; one small golden addition-plus between them. Tiny turquoise drops only, no drinking cup and no tower. Additional free-water access, NOT beer or alcohol.

cards.name: High Pressure
cards.effect: Water tower adds +4 flow to each tap.
cards.subject: One bold dark teal elevated cylindrical farm water tank on four clear sturdy legs, with a turquoise water-drop emblem on its tank and a short bold turquoise stream curving from an outlet pipe near its base. Entire tower visible including tank and feet. No extra taps, cup or plus symbol. Water flow infrastructure.

cards.name: Smooth Operators
cards.effect: All stewards walk faster and gain calming and confrontation skill.
cards.subject: One prominent teal steward reflective safety vest with broad cream reflective bands, centred over a simple golden training rosette with two short ribbons; three restrained turquoise motion strokes to one side imply faster trained movement. No plus symbol, no second vest, no medical bag. Training for stewards, not a new hiring slot.

cards.name: First Responders
cards.effect: All medics walk faster and treat more quickly.
cards.subject: One prominent dark teal medical carry bag with large cream heart emblem, a golden lightning bolt to its side and three turquoise motion strokes. Recognisably trained fast medical response. No red cross, no plus symbol, no second bag, no vest. Not a hiring-capacity image.

cards.name: Something in the Water
cards.subject: Adapt the exact approved anchor artwork in image1: dark teal tap at left pouring turquoise water into cream cup below right, golden sun rays upper right and teal/sage leaves low corners. Preserve this recognised composition and ceramic character. Output ONLY its artwork as a standalone panel; remove all title/effect/paper card portions. Extend cream tiled background at the sides as necessary for landscape 3:2, do not squash objects.

cards.name: Thirsty Crowd
cards.subject: Three simple dark teal festival guest bust silhouettes with clearly separated round heads, two smaller behind one foreground, and one large turquoise water droplet overhead; three small golden sun rays at upper right. No smiling faces, no tap, no cup, no medical symbol. More rapid thirst in a crowd, not satisfaction.

cards.name: Beer Festival
cards.effect: Charge 50% more for beer and everyone loves it.
cards.subject: Two frothy golden-amber pint glasses raised and clinking in a cheers at the centre: cream foam heads, with a few small splash tesserae; one glass slightly nearer and larger. Behind the glasses, a short string of three or four triangular bunting pennants (teal, golden yellow, cream) runs across the top. Warm gold sun rays; sage and teal leaves in the low corners. No people, hands, faces, bottles, kegs, tap handles, price tags, £ signs, numerals or text. No drunkenness cues. A celebratory drinks festival, not water.

cards.name: Friendly Queues
cards.effect: Guests chat in queues and gain satisfaction while they wait.
cards.subject: Two overlapping cream speech bubbles with only turquoise eyes and smiling mouths directly on the cream tiles, no circular backing. Below are two dark teal queue posts and a sagging gold rope, golden rays and sage/teal foliage. No lettering or people.

cards.name: Bring Your Own Bottle
cards.effect: Guests get thirsty more slowly, but take longer to fill up at taps.
cards.subject: A reusable teal water bottle with a cream cap and band, upright under one dark teal standpipe tap (the same tap design as the suite) at the left. A big, generous turquoise stream glugs from the spout into the bottle's neck, with a few large droplets. Golden sun rays upper right; sage leaves low. One tap only, no plus symbol, no cup, no people. Reads as a big bottle that lasts, filled slowly: the stream can be steady rather than gushing.

cards.name: Cola Fiends
cards.effect: Guests prefer soft drinks to free water.
cards.subject: User-approved v5: cropped geometric teal adult face in three-quarter view, angular sage nose and cream eye shapes. A straight golden straw rises diagonally from the lower edge toward the mouth/nose area, with the drink out of shot. Cream background, golden rays and tile border, teal/sage foliage. Text-free, no red, branding, cups or substances.

cards.name: Alcoholics
cards.effect: Guests buy more beer... For better or worse.
cards.subject: A stack of three empty pint glasses: two at the base, one balanced on top. The stack is tipping slightly to one side. A little amber dregs and foam at the bottom of each glass. Three short golden wobble or motion lines beside the top glass hint at risk. Muted sun rays; sage leaves low. No people, faces, vomit, bottles, money or numerals. Light-hearted caution, not squalor.

cards.name: Robot Workers
cards.effect: Staff never need to drink, eat, cool off or use the loo.
cards.subject: One friendly front-on robot with turquoise eye tiles, golden-tip antenna and teal steward vest with cream reflective bands. Both hands empty; no clipboard, mouth or text. Golden rays and sage/teal foliage.
